Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE corrected live mTLS + app HTTP probe to CORE (no secrets printed)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
CERT_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.crt
KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.key
CA_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt
API_KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/api.key
echo CERT_FILE="$CERT_FILE"
echo KEY_FILE="$KEY_FILE"
echo CA_FILE="$CA_FILE"
echo API_KEY_FILE="$API_KEY_FILE"
CERTS_READY=0
API_KEY_READY=0
if [ -n "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -n "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -n "$CA_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -f "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CA_FILE" ]; then
  CERTS_READY=1
fi
if [ -n "$API_KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$API_KEY_FILE" ]; then
  API_KEY_READY=1
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
echo API_KEY_READY=$API_KEY_READY
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ATTEMPT_TLS_VERIFICATION_EDGE_TO_CORE"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "$CA_FILE" \
    -cert "$CERT_FILE" \
    -key "$KEY_FILE" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/tls_verify.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo TLS_VERIFY_EXIT=0
  else
    echo TLS_VERIFY_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- tls verify head ---"
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/tls_verify.txt"
else
  echo TLS_PROBE_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_openssl
fi
echo APPLICATION_PROBE_START
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && [ "$API_KEY_READY" = "1" ] && command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ATTEMPT_APPLICATION_REQUEST_EDGE_TO_CORE"
  if curl -sS --max-time 30 --cert "$CERT_FILE" --key "$KEY_FILE" --cacert "$CA_FILE" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat "$API_KEY_FILE")" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"session_id\":\"live-recovery-probe\",\"command\":\"echo RAGIN_MTLS_HELLO\",\"request_id\":\"rrp-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)\"}" \
    https://172.31.17.217:8443/ragin/v1/command > "${TMPDIR}/app_response.json" 2>"${TMPDIR}/app_response_err.txt"; then
    echo APP_CURL_EXIT=0
  else
    echo APP_CURL_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- app response head ---"
  head -n 300 "${TMPDIR}/app_response.json" 2>/dev/null || echo APP_RESPONSE_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
  echo "--- app error head ---"
  head -n 300 "${TMPDIR}/app_response_err.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo APP_ERROR_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
else
  echo APP_PROBE_SKIPPED=no_cert_or_no_apikey_or_no_curl
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
echo DONE
